DEFINE.core_strategy: Establish a standardized, event-driven state container for collaborative quadrants that decouples the session-scoped data model from the real-time synchronization layer.

rejected_alternatives.tradeoff: Introduces significant latency and overhead compared to event-driven subscriptions.

risks.description: Realtime subscription limits on the backend could constrain concurrent user scaling.
risks.impact: High; users might experience synchronization failures in large groups.
risks.mitigation: Implement client-side connection batching and robust error handling for subscription drops.

DEFINE.thesis: Quadra will accelerate team decision-making by replacing ad-hoc alignment tools with a structured, real-time synchronized quadrant framework.

goals.description: Implement a robust workspace instantiation process.
goals.why: To provide an immediate, reliable start point for team alignment sessions.
goals.success_metric: Successful session creation and record persistence in under 2 seconds.

success_criteria.measurement: Client-side timestamp delta for message propagation

non_goals.description: Building a persistent document management system for the workspaces.
non_goals.tradeoff: Focuses effort on real-time team alignment rather than long-term document storage.

walkthrough.name: User initiates session creation
today: User manually creates an empty document and copies a template structure.
with_strategy: User provides a feature name and receives a unique session link.
Team members access the link and see quadrants in real-time.
